name: Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer
description: An Imperial-class Star Destroyer of the Galactic Empire once captured a YT-2400 light freighter operated by a smuggler and the astromech droid A4-J4. The impounded light freighter and its confiscated cargo were held aboard the Star Destroyer, while the vessel's occupants were incarcerated in the warship's detention cells. However, the smuggler and their fellow detainees broke out of their cell and, retrieving A4-J4 and their cargo, ultimately boarded their starship. The light freighter then blasted its way out of the Star Destroyer's hangar and eventually escaped into hyperspace.
